argv:
set -e
trap 'cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak > /out/preparation.memory; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events > /out/preparation.memory-events' EXIT
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=0 -o Acquire::http::Timeout=30 update
apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=0 -o Acquire::http::Timeout=30 install --no-install-recommends -y python3
cat /etc/os-release > /out/environment.txt
python3 --version >> /out/environment.txt
ldd --version >> /out/environment.txt
dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package}=${Version}\n' | sort > /out/dependencies.txt
network_scope: Debian signed package repositories; runtime journey uses network=none
